name: pebble-audio
description: Your private archive of all-day voice-recorded conversations: day recaps, week and month briefs, searchable transcripts, follow-ups, and clips on request.

interface.longDescription: Pebble Audio keeps your own all-day voice recordings as conversations with titles, summaries, and transcripts, plus day recaps, week and month briefs, and follow-ups. Ask what happened on a day, what you discussed with someone, what you promised, or where a topic came up. Every answer links to the exact moment. Quiet stretches are shown as quiet, not as missing audio.
defaultPrompt: What did I agree to yesterday?
